description: This file sets up and runs a multimedia processing pipeline for a WebRTC-based bot, integrating speech-to-text, language modeling, text-to-speech, and video services, with event handling for client connections.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps in the multimedia pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Holds configuration options for a pipeline task.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline, including handling signals and cancellation.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs context with user and assistant aggregators for conversation management.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for user-side aggregation of LLM interactions.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for handling user turns in the conversation.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when to stop a user turn based on analysis.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the multimedia processing pipeline with event handlers.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializing transport and starting the pipeline.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to run the script, invoking the main function from pipecat.runner.run.
